description: CI-enforced accuracy floors, per backend. Ratcheted 28 Jul 2026 to the 95% programme targets after hardening phases 1-4 landed (baseline: recall 57.0%/62.0%, adverse 57.9%/77.3%, repeat 50%). recall_min is the headline 95% floor; fn_count_max pins the ACHIEVED miss budget (2 documented residuals on the Python engines since the 29 Jul 2026 near-exact-core gate recovered r081; 3 on js) so no new miss can hide under the rate floor. negative_clear_min gates unnoted hard-negative hits only (noted budgeted canaries are reported separately). Ratcheted 5 Aug 2026: the JS engine's decisive min(full, core) scoring (screen.py match_score parity, replacing the collapse-to-core max() trade-off) cleared the single-shared-distinctive-token corporate class (n086-n090), so the JS negative floor joins the Python engines at 1.0. Floors may only rise — lowering one requires MLRO sign-off through model-validation change control (docs/governance/screening-accuracy-benchmark.md).
